findings.fix: Retained SwiftUI import now rejects missing databases, reads bounded strict UTF-8, validates the complete document before writing, and uses the existing atomic/deduplicated importBatch transaction. Success reports actual imported and skipped duplicate counts. Invalid documents and later SQLite failures cannot leave a partial import; generic imports retain existing delivery exclusion and arbitrary ADIF fields.
findings.tests: Four shared transfer regressions cover mixed valid/invalid records, malformed suffix, repeated imports and stable identity, preserved APP_TEST, closed database rejection, actual second-row SQLite trigger failure/rollback/retry, invalid UTF-8 and file bounds, and full frozen export beyond the display cap.
findings.verification: `XLOG_PORTABLE_ONLY=1 swift test --scratch-path .build/prototype-tests --no-parallel --filter 'LegacyADIFTransfer|ADIFPlanning|ADIFImport|LogbookContact'` PASS16 tests/2 suites, 2.446s (four new transfer tests plus twelve contact lifecycle controls); `swift build --product om0rx-xlog` PASS52.22s, compiling the actual retained SwiftUI entry points. `git diff --check` PASS.
findings.limits: No native file chooser or production workspace operated. Import intentionally rejects the entire invalid document instead of silently accepting a prefix; users must correct invalid records before retry. UTF-8 and 32 MiB limit match the modern transfer boundary. Retained SwiftUI path remains synchronous; large-file UI latency/memory and installed-app acceptance were not measured. Existing data is not rewritten.

findings.fix: Export uses the shared database adifExportSnapshot(.all) instead of the search/display-limited qsos collection. The chooser explicitly identifies all non-deleted logbook contacts as scope; count comes from the frozen snapshot and file replacement remains atomic. Missing database is an explicit error.
findings.tests: Create2003 contacts, demonstrate the display fetch cap2000, compare every frozen export contact ID with the complete source set, add another contact after freezing and parse the original snapshot back to exactly2003 records with no late contact. Shared import and revision-fenced contact tests provide neighboring controls.
findings.verification: Shared CR-009 command PASS16 tests/2 suites, including all four new transfer tests; actual `swift build --product om0rx-xlog` PASS52.22s. `git diff --check` PASS.
findings.limits: No native chooser/installed app or production data used. All scope is explicit and preserves the existing exclusion of deleted contacts. Snapshot is one database read view; very large export UI latency/memory and filesystem power-loss durability are not qualified.
